description: Tests the offset database CRUD operations and labware management after the labware refactoring. labware_dict.toml now contains only pipette definitions; labware is referenced by Opentrons load names in settings.toml; calibration offsets live in offset_database.toml.

scenarios.name: Create new offset entry for labware in slot
scenarios.description: Agent uses ot2_add_labware_definition (update_labware_offset) to create a calibration offset entry in offset_database.toml for a specific labware+slot combination.
scenarios.prompt: Use the add_labware_definition tool to save a calibration offset for labware 'nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat' in deck slot '4' with offset_x=-0.5, offset_y=0.8, offset_z=-0.3.

scenarios.name: Update existing offset entry
scenarios.description: Agent saves an offset, then updates it. The second call should overwrite the values for the same labware+slot combination.
multi_turn: Use add_labware_definition to save an offset for labware 'biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr' in slot '2' with offset_x=0.1, offset_y=0.2, offset_z=-0.1.
Now update the same labware 'biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr' in slot '2' with new values: offset_x=-0.3, offset_y=0.5, offset_z=0.0. Use the add_labware_definition tool again.

scenarios.name: Save multiple offsets for different slots
scenarios.description: Agent saves calibration offsets for two different labware items in different slots. Both should appear in offset_database.toml.
scenarios.prompt: Save calibration offsets for two labware items: (1) 'corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat' in slot '1' with offset_x=-0.2, offset_y=0.3, offset_z=-0.1 and (2) 'nest_12_reservoir_15ml' in slot '5' with offset_x=0.0, offset_y=-0.4, offset_z=0.2. Use the add_labware_definition tool for each.

scenarios.name: Save offset with notes field
scenarios.description: Agent saves a calibration offset including optional notes about the calibration session.
scenarios.prompt: Use add_labware_definition to save an offset for labware 'greiner_384_wellplate_240ul' in slot '3' with offset_x=-0.5, offset_y=0.0, offset_z=-0.2. Add the note: 'Calibrated after plate warping correction'.

scenarios.name: Labware dict has no catalog entries
scenarios.description: Verify that labware_dict.toml only contains pipette definitions after the refactoring. It should NOT have [[labware]] entries.
scenarios.prompt: Read the labware configuration file (config://labware resource) and tell me what it contains. Does it have pipette definitions? Does it have labware catalog entries?

scenarios.name: Natural language: calibrate a plate for slot 4
scenarios.description: User asks in natural language to calibrate/add offsets. Agent should identify and use add_labware_definition.
scenarios.prompt: I just ran labware position check in the Opentrons app. For the 96-well plate in slot 4 (labware ID: nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat), the calibration showed I need to shift x by -0.5mm, y by 0.3mm, and z by -0.2mm. Save these calibration offsets.
